text: Discipline in an army is like the laws in civil society. There can be no liberty in a commonwealth where the laws are not revered and most sacredly observed, nor can there be happiness or safety in an army for a single hour where the discipline is not observed.
author: John Adams
reference: Familiar Letters of John Adams and His Wife Abigail Adams
locator: Letter 202, John Adams to Abigail Adams, Philadelphia, 24 August, 1777
